paths.lock_file.description: Path to the PID/lock file to ensure only one sesman instance runs.

paths.session_dir.description: Directory where session metadata, logs, and state files are stored.

limits.max_sessions_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions per user (0 = unlimited).

limits.idle_timeout.description: Idle session timeout (seconds). When exceeded, the session is terminated. 0 = disable.

security.secure_mode.description: Enable secure mode (requires valid TLS certificates for RDP/VNC backends).

security.check_home_dir.description: Verify user's home directory exists and is accessible before launching session.

logging.log_file.description: Path to the main sesman log file (use 'SysLog' to log via system logger instead).

security.allow_root_login.description: Allow root user to log in (not recommended in production).

security.min_uid.description: Minimum UID allowed to log in (e.g., skip system accounts).

security.login_attempt_max.description: Maximum login attempts before temporary lockout (0 = disable lockout).

security.login_attempt_lock_time.description: Lockout duration (seconds) after exceeding max login attempts.

logging.enable_syslog.description: Redirect sesman logs to system syslog instead of a file.

logging.syslog_level.description: Syslog priority level (e.g., 'info', 'debug', 'error') when syslog is enabled.

logging.debug_enable_x11rdp.description: Enable verbose debugging for the X11rdp backend (for troubleshooting).

chansrv.enable.description: Enable channel server (required for drive redirection, clipboard sync, etc.).

chansrv.log_file.description: Optional separate log file for chansrv (empty = use main sesman log).

chansrv.max_channels.description: Maximum number of channels per session.

chansrv.sound_redirect.description: Redirect PulseAudio audio to the RDP client.

sessions.default_wm.description: Default command/shell to launch on session login (e.g., '/bin/bash', 'startgnome').

sessions.display_base.description: Base display number for X sessions (e.g., user sessions start at :10, :20...).

sessions.enable_resize.description: Allow desktop resizing during an active session (client-dependent).

sessions.max_width.description: Maximum desktop width in pixels (0 = no limit).

sessions.max_height.description: Maximum desktop height in pixels (0 = no limit).

sessions.reuse_sessions.description: Reuse existing sessions for returning users instead of creating new ones.

sessions.idle_session_timeout.description: Idle session timeout (seconds) after disconnect (0 = disable auto-termination).

sessions.kill_disconnected_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before terminating a disconnected session (0 = keep indefinitely).

sessions.types.description: Allowed session types (comma-separated list of supported backends).

sessions.wait_time.description: Seconds to wait for a session to start before timing out.

sessions.default_type.description: Default session type shown in login screen (must be in `sessions.types`).

command.description: Command to launch this session type (e.g., '/usr/bin/mywm').

order.description: Sort priority for display in login menu (lower = shown first).

enabled.description: Show this session type in login menu?

sessions.custom_sessions.description: List of custom session type definitions (beyond built-in Xvnc/X11rdp).

polkit.enable.description: Enable PolicyKit for session management permissions (e.g., session control via DBus).
